retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel grid layout featuring a large primary subject and smaller action sequences framed by bold color blocks and heavy sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured 1960s graphic layout divided into three main zones: a horizontal orange header with heavy blue and purple text, a central white-bordered grid containing one large portrait and six smaller action shots against dark backgrounds, and a vertical blue sidebar containing tracklist information and a spiral logo.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast color blocking between orange, blue, and white
Hierarchical grid separating the lead performer from the ensemble
Repetition of dark studio backgrounds across all photographic panels
Juxtaposition of heavy display type with smaller functional metadata
coreInvariants: White gutter lines between all photographic panels
Subject isolation against deep black backgrounds
Primary color palette of vibrant orange and cyan-blue

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject occupies the large left-hand vertical rectangle; secondary subjects occupy a 2x3 grid to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large orange header block at the top containing the main title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-left title leads to the main portrait, then scans the grid to the right, finishing on the blue sidebar tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White borders act as structural negative space to define the grid.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation primaries against low-value black photographic backgrounds.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with minimal stroke contrast
Tight letter spacing in display roles
characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphens in title are elongated to match stroke thickness
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display sans-serif paired with a lighter, more legible grotesque for lists.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the sturdy, mid-century grotesque feel of the sidebar text.
Captures the density and weight of the main header title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a grid layout with a large vertical rectangle on the left and a 2x3 grid of smaller rectangles on the right, all with white borders. Fill the top with a solid orange header and the far right with a solid blue vertical bar. Populate the rectangles with studio photography of dancers against black backgrounds.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy blue sans-serif uppercase text to the orange header. Add a list of yellow-gold uppercase text to the blue sidebar. Place a purple and pink spiral logo in the top right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the grid defined by clear white gutters?
Are the subjects isolated against a dark background?
Is the header text significantly heavier than the sidebar text?
Are the orange and blue blocks solid and vibrant?

postGenerationChecks: Check that text is legible against the color blocks.
Ensure the grid is perfectly symmetrical in its spacing.
Verify the '1960s soul' aesthetic is maintained through font choice.
Confirm the main subject is clearly the focal point.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid Header + Vertical Sidebar + Multi-Panel Photographic Grid = Mid-Century Instructional Album Aesthetic
